column1: # runtime-cost-constants.tsv — the step-1 runtime cost model's constants of
# record (runtime-cost-model-design.md §3 rule 1: a routing constant without
# provenance and an automated honesty check is a latent regression).
# Structural twin of m5-coverage.tsv. Pinned against
# generated by scripts/runtime-cost-fit.py from the m5-5 crossover ladder
# legacy per-row work == 1; verdicts are ratio comparisons, absolute anchor
# cancels; step 2 rebases to cost units via the t34 anchor).
# Model: t_rt = c_engage + w_row*N/D; t_leg = l_setup + N/min(D,l_cap);

# PROVISIONAL(v1-contaminated) — the v1 rowflip vehicle's serial/legacy
# preludes ran the RUNTIME arm on a dev binary (scratchpad/night/
# hj-ladder-v2-and-seat-letter.md, control job -2224). The values encode
# THE SHIPPED FLOORS' BASIS (correct for the step-1 SHADOW parity bar);
# no PGRUST_M5_COST_ROUTE flip may cite them. Refit from the witnessed v2
# values known so far are carried in the per-class c_engage notes.
# Term classes beyond the curve terms:
#                      the curve); owner column names the letter owed.
#   admission_*      — executor-admission MIRROR, never retired by cost
